note: Households from the 1901 census whose address is a house name with no number, where the record holds no property that answers to that name. They are parked here rather than imported: a name alone cannot be filed to a house, and creating a property for each would invent two dozen houses on the strength of a single return. This file is deliberately NOT named people_*.json, so the importer never reads it. When a name is matched to a house — by directory, deed, or the numbering on a later census — lift that household out of here into a proper import file. Lincoln Villa was in this file until the record turned out to hold it as 11 Western Terrace (#350); it has gone into the import instead.
source: 1901 census — transcribed by A. Hagues from the enumerators' pages
already_unfiled_in_the_record: Clumber Lodge and Newlands, both Lenton Avenue, went in with the Lenton Avenue import before this rule was made. They are in the record as unfiled 1901 records and can be set aside on /unfiled until their houses are known.
